item_short_desc: Rothco’s Mini LED Flashlight features a classic right-angle design, perfect for public safety, outdoorsmen, and anyone in need of a reliable light source. This compact survival flashlight is easy to store on your waist, inside your pack, or in your pocket, providing quick access to light whenever needed. The flashlight is equipped with 6 LED bulbs: 3 clear, 1 red, one blue, and one green, offering versatile lighting options. It runs on 2 AA batteries (not included).
description: Rothco’s Mini LED Flashlight features a classic right-angle design, perfect for public safety, outdoorsmen, and anyone in need of a reliable light source. This compact survival flashlight is easy to store on your waist, inside your pack, or in your pocket, providing quick access to light whenever needed. The flashlight is equipped with 6 LED bulbs: 3 clear, 1 red, one blue, and one green, offering versatile lighting options. It runs on 2 AA batteries (not included) and features IP44 waterproofing, ensuring durability in various weather conditions. The right-angle design with a rear clip allows you to attach the flashlight to your pants or shirt for hands-free use, making it ideal for survivalists, camping enthusiasts, and more. With its sturdy construction and practical design, the Rothco Mini LED Flashlight is a must-have for anyone seeking a dependable light source.
